description: Historical car and engine traces from the stable read surface. Pick the one-second aggregate or the raw samples with Trace source. The live gauges are on Car: live.

links.title: Car camera
links.tooltip: Open the car camera straight from the pit's video relay, outside Grafana

panels.description: Surge tank float switch voltage (PDM16 SPI 1), lowest reading in each interval so a blip of a fraction of a second still shows. 5 V is fuel in the surge tank; a drop towards 0 V is the switch closing (surge light). Widen the time range to see how often it blips.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS time, min(value) AS "Surge switch lowest"
FROM v_samples_named
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'
  AND channel = 'car.surge_tank_switch'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Surge tank switch

panels.description: Driver's pedal against the drive-by-wire throttle blade, both in percent on one axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS time, avg(avg) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.accel_pedal_pos') AS "Throttle pedal", avg(avg) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.throttle_pos') AS "Throttle position (TPS)"
FROM v_samples_1s_named
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'
  AND channel IN ('car.accel_pedal_pos', 'car.throttle_pos')
  AND (
    '$session' = 'all'
    OR time BETWEEN
      COALESCE((SELECT min(crossed_at) FROM v_laps WHERE session_id::text = '$session' AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'), '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      AND COALESCE((SELECT max(crossed_at) FROM v_laps WHERE session_id::text = '$session' AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'), 'infinity'::timestamptz)
  )
  AND '$trace_source' = 'v_samples_1s_named'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS time, avg(value) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.accel_pedal_pos') AS "Throttle pedal", avg(value) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.throttle_pos') AS "Throttle position (TPS)"
FROM v_samples_named
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'
  AND channel IN ('car.accel_pedal_pos', 'car.throttle_pos')
  AND (
    '$session' = 'all'

list.query: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
